cluster_label: body_follicle stem cell and prefollicle cell
working_definition: Germarium somatic cells: follicle stem cells and their prefollicle cell progeny in the adult ovary (Li et al. 2022, Fly Cell Atlas). Authors gave 'Manual Annotation' (no FBbt id); broad class somatic precursor cell.
searches_performed: follicle stem cell and prefollicle cell

best_match.fbbt_definition: Somatic cell that is part of the ovariole. This does not include the ovarian sheath.

justification: Grouped call of two types. Both follicle stem cell (FBbt:00004903) and prefollicle cell (FBbt:00047835) have somatic cell of ovariole as a direct parent (verified via OLS); the follicle stem cell is also a somatic stem cell, and prefollicle is not a follicle cell, so somatic cell of ovariole is the most specific common ancestor.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Stem cell from which the follicle cells that envelop the germline cyst derive. There are two follicle stem cells in each germarium.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Group member; not a parent of prefollicle cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Somatic cell of the germarium that differentiates from a follicle stem cell and can differentiate into a follicle cell.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Group member; not a parent of follicle stem cell.

recommendation: Map to somatic cell of ovariole (FBbt:00006030), broad match.
